name: SAT2002 Competition
description: SAT Competition 2002 held in March‐May 2002 in conjunction with SAT 2002 (the Fifth International Symposium on the Theory and Applications of Satisfiability Testing). About 30 solvers and 2300 benchmarks took part in the competition, which required more than 2 CPU years to complete the evaluation. In this report, we give the results of the competition, try to interpret them, and give suggestions for future competitions.
evaluation_method: number_of_instances_solved within time/memory limits (solver score) and solver runtime
notes: Large, diverse collection of SAT instances used for solver competition; non-LLM benchmark whose results are sensitive to hardware, time limits, and solver configuration; historical dataset — may be outdated relative to modern SAT workloads.
